rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the flax plant itself.

example.english: This flax has blue flowers and a slender, tall stalk.
example.traditional: 呢種亞麻開住藍色花，莖又細又高。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 aa3 maa4 hoi1 zyu6 laam4 sik1 faa1 ging3 jau6 sai3 jau6 gou1

rows.note: Use this when flax specifically refers to the seeds rather than the plant.

example.english: I add a spoonful of flax to my yogurt every day.
example.traditional: 我每日都會喺乳酪入面加一匙亞麻籽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui6 hai2 jyu5 lok6 jap6 min6 gaa1 jat1 ci4 aa3 maa4 zi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the fibers used to make linen and related textiles.

example.english: This shirt is woven from flax and feels very breathable.
example.traditional: 呢件衫用亞麻纖維織，着落好透氣。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 jung6 aa3 maa4 cim1 wai4 zik1 zoek6 lok6 hou2 tau3 hei3
